claim: SOX record high ~14,655 marks a cycle top; broad upcycle is in
claim_zh: SOX ~14,655 的历史高点就是这轮周期的顶；全面上行的行情已经走完

manual.note: Broadening breadth (no SOX A/D data feed); Broadcom AI outlook is an event-driven leg with no compilable proxy

source_prose: SOX breaking above the 2026 record high ~14,655 on a sustained basis refutes the cycle-top thesis; breadth confirmation (SOX A/D line) and Broadcom AI revenue guide are manual residuals

claim: DRAM ASP trough is in; memory upcycle underway
claim_zh: DRAM 均价的底已经出来了；存储周期开始往上走

manual.note: All compilable legs require paywalled data: DRAM spot ASP (DRAMeXchange), spot DDR5 contract prices. No free proxy available.

source_prose: DRAM ASP turning negative quarter-over-quarter, or DDR5 spot prices breaking below contract floor, would refute the upcycle thesis. Both series are paywalled.

claim: Housing cycle has turned; price appreciation and permit issuance confirm upcycle
claim_zh: 地产周期已经转向；房价涨幅和营建许可一起印证上行
source_prose: Case-Shiller HPI rising >5% YoY for 3+ months AND building permits >= 1,500K for 2+ months together refute a housing downturn thesis; either leg alone is insufficient

claim: Business cycle is in expansion; labor market and employment confirm growth regime
claim_zh: 经济周期还在扩张；就业市场和新增岗位印证仍是增长格局

manual.note: ISM Manufacturing >54 is the canonical expansion confirmation leg but no free ISM feed is collected; DSL approximates via Sahm Rule + payroll growth

source_prose: Sahm Rule below 0.5 (no recession signal) AND payroll growth positive YoY refute a business-cycle contraction thesis; ISM >54 is an uncompiled residual

claim: Oil is in a structural range; extreme price moves signal regime shift
claim_zh: 原油还在结构性区间里；只有极端价格才说明格局要切换
source_prose: WTI crude sustained below $55 for 42 days (demand-collapse/OPEC+breakdown) or above $95 for 42 days (supply-shock upcycle) each refute the range-bound regime thesis

claim: Copper trough is in; industrial demand recovery supports a new upcycle
claim_zh: 铜价的底已经出来了；工业需求回暖支撑新一轮上行
source_prose: HG futures sustained below $4.082/lb (~$9,000/t) for 42 days refutes bullish trough-is-in thesis; sustained above $6.804/lb (~$15,000/t) confirms extreme upcycle overshoot. Both are regime-refuting extremes.

claim: Uranium supply squeeze is structural; spot U3O8 confirms persistent deficit
claim_zh: 铀的供应紧张是结构性的；U3O8 现货价印证缺口一直没补上

manual.note: Spot U3O8 price is paywalled (UxC, TradeTech). No free proxy available for uranium spot or term contract prices.

source_prose: Spot U3O8 breaking below $65/lb or above $120/lb would each refute the structural-squeeze thesis. Both series are paywalled with no free proxy.

claim: Gold secular bull is intact; real-rate repricing and de-dollarization support
claim_zh: 黄金的长期牛市没走完；实际利率重定价和去美元化在托底
source_prose: Gold futures sustained below $3,300 for 21 days refutes the secular bull thesis and signals a structural break in the 2024-2026 upcycle

claim: Bitcoin's mid-cycle washout is complete and a new upcycle begins, with strength into year end
claim_zh: 比特币中周期洗盘已结束，新一轮上行周期开启，年底前走强

manual.note: Ungraded residuals, disclosed: (a) death-by-drift — BTC ranging above 48,000 leaves every clause ungraded until expiry, and EXPIRED drops out of both forward counters silently; (b) the 'strength into year end' clause has no DSL leg; (c) the real-rate driver is deliberately NOT a leg — in the 2022-10 exemplar DFII10 rose 100bp from the FTX low to its 2.52 peak (2023-10-25) while BTC rallied +180%, so a rate-high leg false-kills the motivating episode; the mechanism is tracked by transmission chain real_rate_peak_crypto_rerate rev 1, whose own falsifier fails the chain on a fresh real-rate high

source_prose: BTC closing below $48,000 refutes the completed-washout thesis: -18.0% below the 2026-06-30 basing low (close 58,559), one point deeper than the closest motivating exemplar's post-rate-peak retest (2022: June base close 19,018 -> FTX low close 15,787 = -17.0%, before the +180% rally), so an exemplar-shaped washout survives while a deeper break kills the claim; 2018's -43% capitulation (5,648 -> 3,237) rightly refuses it — that path contradicts 'washout complete'. v2 re-author 2026-08-10: v1's post-halving bull claim was refuted 2026-07-02 (fired leg lt 64000; close 61,485) and its latched state row stays as history; v2 registers the operator's successor thesis. Evidence base thin and printed as such: 2 clean analog episodes (2018-12, 2022-10; 2020 QE-contaminated, excluded). Leg unfired at registration (close 65,035 on 2026-08-09): the v2 entry ARMS fresh

claim: Credit cycle is in benign expansion; spreads confirm risk appetite
claim_zh: 信用周期处在温和扩张；信用利差说明风险偏好还在

manual.note: Loan default rate (Fed Senior Loan Officer Survey net tightening) is a key confirmatory leg but no granular free feed is collected in this system

source_prose: HY OAS spiking above 500bps refutes benign expansion; HY OAS sustained below 300bps for 63 days signals froth/complacency, also refuting a healthy-cycle thesis. Loan default rate is a manual residual.

claim: Shipping cycle is in recovery; BDI and container rates confirm global trade demand
claim_zh: 航运周期正在复苏；BDI 和集装箱运价印证全球贸易需求

manual.note: Baltic Dry Index (BDI) is paywalled. No free daily proxy for dry-bulk or container freight rates (Freightos FBX requires subscription).

source_prose: BDI breaking below 1,000 or above 3,500 would each refute the cycle-recovery thesis. All shipping rate series are paywalled.

claim: Lithium structural deficit is intact; EV demand supports price floor
claim_zh: 锂的结构性缺口还在；电动车需求托住价格底部

manual.note: Spot Li2CO3 (battery-grade, China) is paywalled (Fastmarkets, SMM). No free proxy for lithium carbonate or hydroxide spot prices.

source_prose: Spot Li2CO3 breaking below CNY 70,000/t or sustained recovery above CNY 120,000/t would each refute the current deficit/oversupply positioning. All series are paywalled.

claim: Corn/grain complex is in structural upcycle driven by weather and energy costs
claim_zh: 玉米等谷物处在结构性上行周期，驱动来自天气和能源成本
source_prose: Corn futures sustained above $5.75/bu for 42 days confirms the grain upcycle thesis is intact (and thus fires as a regime-level falsifier for bearish/range views); sustained break below this level would invalidate the upcycle. v2 re-author: yahoo:ZC=F quotes in CENTS per bushel (439.0 = $4.39/bu), so the v1 threshold of 5.75 was trivially true forever and the 2026-07-02 fire was a unit artifact, not a market fire; $5.75/bu = 575 in tape units

claim: Volatility is in a suppressed regime; VIX sub-20 reflects structural calm
claim_zh: 波动率被压在低位；VIX 长期站在 20 下方，是结构性的平静
source_prose: VIX sustained above 27.5 for 5 days refutes the suppressed-volatility regime thesis and signals structural risk-off transition

claim: Biotech is in a new upcycle; XBI breadth and M&A pipeline confirm
claim_zh: 生物科技进入新一轮上行周期；XBI 的上涨宽度和并购储备一起印证
source_prose: XBI sustained below $122.50 for 21 days refutes the upcycle thesis (new bear leg); XBI above $175 signals blow-off/froth that also refutes the early-upcycle positioning

claim: Long bonds have bottomed; 30yr yield peak and TLT recovery confirm duration is buyable
claim_zh: 长债已经见底；30 年期收益率见顶、TLT 企稳回升，说明久期可以买了
source_prose: 30yr yield above 5.2%, 10yr above 4.9%, or TLT below $83 each independently refute the long-bond bottoming/recovery thesis

claim: Dollar is in a structural bear cycle; DXY below 100 with declining inflation confirms
claim_zh: 美元处在结构性下行周期；美元指数跌破 100 叠加通胀回落予以印证

manual.note: Dovish FOMC pivot (explicit rate-cut cycle initiation) is an event-driven leg; the compiled DXY + CPI legs proxy the macro outcome. Reclassified FULL as the proxy captures the signal adequately.

source_prose: DXY weekly close below 97 AND CPI YoY below 4% together refute a dollar-bull or sticky-inflation thesis; dovish FOMC pivot is a manual event residual proxied by these legs

claim: Natural gas is in a seasonal squeeze; summer heat and LNG export demand confirm
claim_zh: 天然气正在季节性紧张里；夏季高温和 LNG 出口需求一起印证

manual.note: EIA storage vs 5-year seasonal average is the canonical structural-deficit indicator but EIA storage data is not currently collected in this system

source_prose: Henry Hub above $4.00 for 10 days in Jul-Sep confirms summer squeeze; EIA storage deficit vs 5-yr average is an uncompiled residual leg

claim: Iron ore demand is supported by China construction recovery; 62% Fe seaborne confirms
claim_zh: 铁矿石需求靠中国建筑开工回暖托底；62% 品位海运矿价印证这一点

manual.note: 62% Fe seaborne spot price (SGX, Platts IODEX) is paywalled. No free daily proxy. SGX futures require exchange access.

source_prose: 62% Fe spot breaking below $80/t or rising above $140/t would each refute the balanced-demand thesis. All seaborne iron ore price series are paywalled.

claim: Silver is in an industrial+monetary upcycle; gold-silver ratio compression confirms
claim_zh: 白银处在工业与货币双属性的上行周期；金银比收敛印证这一点

manual.note: Fed pivot to explicit rate cuts is an event-driven catalyst leg; silver above $72 proxies the monetary-premium capture but the Fed event itself has no compilable DSL

source_prose: Silver futures above $72 for 5 days confirms the upcycle overshoot (blow-off refuter); Fed pivot to rate cuts is an uncompiled event residual

claim: EM equities are in a new upcycle; DXY weakness and EM ATH breakout confirm
claim_zh: 新兴市场股市进入新一轮上行周期；美元走弱和新兴市场创历史新高一起印证

manual.note: MSCI-EM ATH rewritten to EEM ~$65 (approximate 2026 ATH level); MSCI-EM index itself is paywalled so EEM ETF is used as proxy. EEM level may drift from MSCI-EM index.

source_prose: EEM crossing above its 2026 ATH (~$65) AND DXY below 99 together confirm EM upcycle; MSCI-EM index (direct) is paywalled so EEM is used as proxy with manual review cadence

claim: Japan is in a structural reflation cycle; Nikkei ATH and weak yen confirm
claim_zh: 日本处在结构性再通胀周期；日经创历史新高和日元走弱一起印证

manual.note: TOPIX A/D breadth line (broadening participation) is not collected; Nikkei + USDJPY proxy the macro reflation but breadth quality is a manual residual

source_prose: Nikkei 225 sustained above 73,000 for 21 days AND USDJPY at or above 160 together confirm the yen-weak reflation cycle; TOPIX A/D breadth is an uncompiled residual

claim: PGMs are in a supply-deficit upcycle; platinum premium vs gold and absolute level confirm
claim_zh: 铂族金属处在供应缺口驱动的上行周期；铂金对黄金的溢价和绝对价位一起印证
source_prose: Platinum above $1,900 (upcycle confirmed), or gold/platinum ratio narrowing below 2.2 (platinum outperforming on relative basis), or platinum below $1,300 (capitulation/bear market) each independently fire as regime-level falsifiers. v2 re-author: the v1 ratio leg computed PL/GC (~0.40), which is trivially below 2.2 forever, so the 2026-07-02 fire was an inverted-ratio artifact, not a market fire; the intended premium metric is GC/PL (currently ~2.48, i.e. not met)

claim: SPX is in a durable bull cycle; breadth and momentum confirm expansion regime
claim_zh: 标普 500 处在可持续的牛市周期；上涨宽度和动量印证扩张格局

manual.note: NYSE A/D line trend and SPX breadth (% above 200MA) are canonical bull-cycle confirmers but are not collected as time series in this system; DSL approximates via price level + Sahm Rule

source_prose: SPX sustained above 5,800 with Sahm Rule below 0.5 approximates an intact bull cycle; breadth metrics (NYSE A/D, % above 200MA) are manual residuals not yet in the data pipeline
